# vendorfake

> High-fidelity fakes of third-party vendor APIs for testing an integration
> without a vendor sandbox: real state, webhooks signed and retried the way
> the vendor does it, and deterministic fault injection.

Unofficial. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to any vendor
named here. Every behaviour is derived from publicly published API
documentation. Four vendors ship today: Square (Connect v2), Clover
(REST v3), Toast (REST v2/v3), Lightspeed Retail X-Series (API 2026-07).

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/konyklabs/vendorfake/blob/main/README.md):
  what vendorfake is, the vendors it covers, the sixty-second quickstart, and
  links into the docs site for everything else.
- [For agents](https://github.com/konyklabs/vendorfake/blob/main/docs/for-agents.md):
  the working contract for a coding agent writing or fixing tests against an
  installed vendorfake -- bindings, vocabulary, discovery commands, and the
  evidence habit.
- [API contract](https://github.com/konyklabs/vendorfake/blob/main/docs/api-contract.md):
  what is public and covered by the deprecation policy, what is internal and
  may move without notice -- the one page that answers "if I import it, will
  it still be there next release?"
- [Seeded scenario](https://github.com/konyklabs/vendorfake/blob/main/docs/seeded-scenario.md):
  the exact ids, credentials and entities every profile starts with, per
  vendor.
- [Async consumers](https://github.com/konyklabs/vendorfake/blob/main/docs/async-consumers.md):
  every async entry point (`async_client`, `async_unit`, the
  `vendorfake_async_unit` fixture) and what a deliberate delay does on each
  binding.
- [The pytest plugin](https://github.com/konyklabs/vendorfake/blob/main/docs/pytest-plugin.md):
  the `vendorfake` marker and its three fixtures (`vendorfake_unit`,
  `vendorfake_async_unit`, `vendorfake_webhook_receiver`) -- the whole surface
  installing the wheel registers.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/konyklabs/vendorfake/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md):
  what changed, release by release.

## Optional

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/konyklabs/vendorfake/blob/main/AGENTS.md):
  for an agent working inside this repository itself (layout, the one
  command, the boundary rules) -- not relevant to a consumer.
